mapper.select: SELECT 'festivals' AS jobKey, '축제/행사' AS jobLabel, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM festivals) AS totalCount, (SELECT MAX(fetched_at) FROM festivals) AS lastFetchedAt UNION ALL SELECT 'exhibitions' AS jobKey, '전시/공연' AS jobLabel, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exhibitions) AS totalCount, (SELECT MAX(fetched_at) FROM exhibitions) AS lastFetchedAt UNION ALL SELECT 'welfare' AS jobKey, '복지 서비스' AS jobLabel, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM welfare_services) AS totalCount, (SELECT MAX(fetched_at) FROM welfare_services) AS lastFetchedAt UNION ALL SELECT 'gas-stations' AS jobKey, '주유소' AS jobLabel, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gas_stations) AS totalCount, (SELECT MAX(fetched_at) FROM gas_prices) AS lastFetchedAt UNION ALL SELECT 'real-estate' AS jobKey, '부동산' AS jobLabel, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM real_estate_transactions) AS totalCount, (SELECT MAX(fetched_at) FROM real_estate_transactions) AS lastFetchedAt UNION ALL SELECT 'real-estate-bootstrap' AS jobKey, '부동산 전체 적재' AS jobLabel, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM real_estate_transactions) AS totalCount, (SELECT MAX(fetched_at) FROM real_estate_transactions) AS lastFetchedAt UNION ALL SELECT 'all' AS jobKey, '전체 동기화' AS jobLabel, ( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM festivals) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exhibitions) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM welfare_services) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gas_stations) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM real_estate_transactions) ) AS totalCount, GREATEST( COALESCE((SELECT MAX(fetched_at) FROM festivals), '1970-01-01'), COALESCE((SELECT MAX(fetched_at) FROM exhibitions), '1970-01-01'), COALESCE((SELECT MAX(fetched_at) FROM welfare_services), '1970-01-01'), COALESCE((SELECT MAX(fetched_at) FROM gas_prices), '1970-01-01'), COALESCE((SELECT MAX(fetched_at) FROM real_estate_transactions), '1970-01-01') ) AS lastFetchedAt
